title: DailyProductionSheet_Downtime
description:
Extract ONLY header identity fields and Reasons For Downtime for all shifts present (D/S, A/S, and N/S when filled) from HPDC Daily Production Sheet PR-FO-4623. Do NOT extract Reject Data, Labour, Machine Counter, Rework, or Minor Stops.

LEFT side of the form only (exclude the vertical Labour / Reject Data band).

SHIFT HEADERS vs DOWNTIME: Fields labeled MEETINGS, POLISH, CHK LIST, CLEAN UP / C/UP FILTERS WATER, Plunger Tip Life Count, Vacuum Valve # belong in the shift summary — NEVER as downtime_entries reasons.

MULTI-LINE REASONS: If a row has reason text but no times, merge that text into the previous timed event's reason. If reason is a ditto mark like ----""------, use the same reason as the row above.

TIME COLUMNS (left to right): M/C Stop (machine stopped) → Maint/T/Room Start (repair started, often blank) → Maint/T/Room Finish (repair finished, often blank) → M/C Start (machine restarted).

Do NOT extract Maint Or T/Room Sign.

Warm Up Prod = warmup_shot_count (number of warmup shots after downtime, NOT minutes).

header.description: Top header handwritten fields for this production day/machine.

machine.description: Header field labeled Machine. Usually 2-4 digit number + one symbol usually # + 1-2 digit number (e.g. 1250#2).

product.description: Header field labeled Product (product/part code as written).

date.description: Header field labeled Date — production date (not footer revision date).

shifts.description: One object per shift block that has any handwritten content. Prefer order N/S, D/S, A/S. Include N/S when present; omit a shift only if that whole block is blank.

plunger_tip_life_count.description: Shift header Plunger Tip Life Count for this shift.

vacuum_valve.description: Shift header Vacuum Valve # as written.

meetings_minutes.description: Shift header MEETINGS minutes. Not a downtime reason.

polish_minutes.description: Shift header POLISH minutes. Not a downtime reason.

chk_list_minutes.description: Shift header CHK LIST minutes. Not a downtime reason.

cleanup_minutes.description: Shift header CLEAN UP or C/UP, FILTERS, WATER minutes. Not a downtime reason.

downtime_entries.description: Logical downtime events for this shift after multi-line/ditto merge. Exclude empty rows. Exclude any row that is only MEETINGS/POLISH/CHK LIST/CLEAN UP header text. Do not extract Sign.

reason.description: Handwritten downtime reason (e.g. Lump on casting, Trim Press fault). Include merged continuation text. Resolve ditto to previous reason.

reason_continued_from_previous.description: True if reason came from a ditto / same-as-above mark.

mc_stop.description: M/C Stop time — when the machine stopped (e.g. 7:50).

maint_troom_start.description: Maint/T/Room Start — when repair/maintenance started. Often blank.

maint_troom_finish.description: Maint/T/Room Finish — when repair/maintenance finished. Often blank.

mc_start.description: M/C Start — when the machine started again.

warmup_shot_count.description: Warm Up Prod — count of warmup shots after this downtime (not minutes).
